g.text: MixTransport ↔ Mix Protocol: one forward and one reverse message
A initiates the session. B is its recipient and the forward path's final Mix hop.
REVERSE · B → A · fresh SURBs for every send
Before Connect: A asks Mix to create return capacity
SURB → serialized into a forward transport frame → B
Credential → stays in A's store, associated with the session
Mix send completed: sender hold + first-hop write completed.
Transport ACK: remote transport reports receipt.
MixTransport owns ordering, retries, flow control and supply.
Application codec selects a stream handler. MixTransport service selects the forward callback. /mix/1.0.0 carries hop-to-hop packets.
